### Contributing guidelines

- [x] I've read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/docker/setup-buildx-action/blob/master/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) and wholeheartedly agree

### I've found a bug, and:

- [x] The documentation does not mention anything about my problem
- [x] There are no open or closed issues that are related to my problem

### Description

I've deployed GitHub runner scale set with docker:28-dind as a sidecar. I have a simple workflow:

```yaml
      - name: "Set up Docker Buildx"
        uses: "docker/setup-buildx-action@v3"
        with:
          buildkitd-config-inline: |
            [registry."docker.io"]
              mirrors = ["mirror.gcr.io"]

      - name: Pull nginx
        run: docker pull nginx
```

But still with this configuration, I encounter an error `Error response from daemon: toomanyrequests: You have reached your unauthenticated pull rate limit. https://www.docker.com/increase-rate-limit`.

### Expected behaviour

mirror.gcr.io should be used and no rate limit should occur.

### Actual behaviour

Error occurs:
```
Error response from daemon: toomanyrequests: You have reached your unauthenticated pull rate limit. https://www.docker.com/increase-rate-limit
```

### Repository URL

_No response_

### Workflow run URL

_No response_

### YAML workflow

```yaml
name: Pull Docker Images

on:
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow manual trigger

jobs:
  pull-images:
    runs-on: myrunner-stg

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: "Set up Docker Buildx"
        uses: "docker/setup-buildx-action@v3"
        with:
          buildkitd-config-inline: |
            [registry."docker.io"]
              mirrors = ["mirror.gcr.io"]

      - name: Pull nginx
        run: docker pull nginx
```
